LESSON: LISTENING FOR INFORMATION, ORAL EXPRESSION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Listening and speaking
Topic 1.4: Listening for information, Oral Expression
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening for information, Oral Expression, part of Listening and speaking in Grade 9 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How do you communicate what you feel/do every day?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss with peers about their daily routine at home/school,

2. discuss with peers about favourite routines,

3. listen to audio of peers talking about daily routine at home (z.B. Ich stehe um 7 Uhr auf; ich esse um 7.30 mein Frühstück; usw), and answer given questions

4. ask and respond to peers: “Was macht er/sie am ____?”

5. demonstrates/pantomimes an activity to peers and asks, “was mache ich am..?”, peers guess

6. listen to audio texts of peers talking about their daily routines at school, (z.B. Ich lerne um/ab 9.20 Mathe; Ich spiele am Nachmittag Fußball; usw),

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss with peers about their daily routine at home/school,
2. discuss with peers about favourite routines,
3. listen to audio of peers talking about daily routine at home (z.B. Ich stehe um 7 Uhr auf; ich esse um 7.30 mein Frühstück; usw), and answer given questions
4. ask and respond to peers: “Was macht er/sie am ____?”
5. demonstrates/pantomimes an activity to peers and asks, “was mache ich am..?”, peers guess
6. listen to audio texts of peers talking about their daily routines at school, (z.B. Ich lerne um/ab 9.20 Mathe; Ich spiele am Nachmittag Fußball; usw),

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening for information, Oral Expression together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and Imagination: the learner develops the skill of making connections when they observe peers pantomime and give

the activity.

Values:
Unity: the learner inculcates the value of cooperation when s/he role-plays his/her routine for the peers to guess.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life Skills: the learner develops awareness for assertiveness when s/he role-plays his/her routine for the peers to guess.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner associates the knowledge acquired on time for the daily routine with the concept of numbers learnt in

Mathematics.
